name: Bioluminescent Desert
description: An endless desert of glowing sand dunes that pulse with soft blue‑green bioluminescence, creating rivers of light that wind across the night landscape.
prompt: Vast desert at night, sand dunes emitting gentle bioluminescent glow, rivers of liquid light winding through, stars overhead, cool blue‑green tones, photorealistic, sense of quiet wonder, no text, immersive atmosphere.
caption: Walk through a desert that shines from within—each step illuminates a luminous pathway through the night.
